name: Palladous-Terminus
description: A killed landscape, vacuum-scoured and silent. The regolith holds bootprints beautifully; there are some near solar wind erosion patterns that no expedition has ever claimed.
The silence has texture, close to audible. Old survey teams left notes about hearing their own heartbeats as knocking.
the smuggler cache was established during the last boom and never decommissioned. Its roster lists eleven souls; life-support draws power for thirty.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
